5182.title: Sticky-row hover compositing is already repaired on main
5182.rootCauseOneLine: An alpha hover background replaces the opaque sticky-row fill; main already layers the accent over an opaque sidebar image.

prReviews.topFinding: Trusted main contains the opaque backing repair; two clean paint runs conceal the underlay.

5182.proposedFix: No new patch: retain merged commit 178fd3c2c4aeef162dea517d850ead11f3b034df and ship it in the next applicable release.
5182.caveats: Paint-boundary harness, not a full live ThreadRow application journey. Desktop hover media blocks explicitly activated in headless Chromium. The release and external evidence were not executed or fetched. Main is fixed; release inclusion is not asserted.
